Four letter-clusters have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the letter-cluster that is different.

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter cluster.)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic: 

First and second letter → (5) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series.

Second and third letter → (1) is subtracted from the position value according to the English alphabetic series.

Third and fourth letter → (1) is subtracted from the position value according to the English alphabetic series.

​​So,

Option - (1): RWVU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf2a512ef606132bb5a5b9222f93631c3744c903fe02d8f3451345acdc5055c8.png]

Thus, out of all the options "IMNL" is the odd one out.

Three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and one is different. Select the odd one
questions.solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/99fc7420a23237787baa0dd63b85ba6fae16b15bb95444f7f9cc2114572a7d37.png] 

According to the alphabetical positions of the letters,

2. LPT → L + 4 = P; P + 4 = T

4. GKO → G + 4 = K; K + 4 = O

Hence, ‘**HLQ** ’ is the odd one out.

questions.question: Four letter-clusters have been given. Out of which three are alike in same manner and one is different. Select the odd letter-cluster.
questions.solution:
The positions of the letters according to the English alphabet series :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7fc278fe789af8222fe6cac882237358a9d0a2182b555ce3565db4085f8b1202.png] 

In each option, the difference between the letters is '-3' except in option 1.

The pattern followed here is :

**1) F + 2 → H ; H + 4 → L ; L + 5 → Q ; Q + 1 → R **

2) N - 3 → K ; K - 3 → H ; H - 3 → E ; E - 3 → B

3) S - 3 → P ; P - 3 → M ; M - 3 → J ; J - 3 → G

4) U - 3 → U ; U + 3 → R ; R + 3 → O ; L + 3 → I

Hence, 'FHLQR' is odd among all.
